title: Prop feed: retry before tripping on a transient terminal outage (timeout / unknown_page), keep rc 4 trips for captcha, 2FA, login_rejected and the other environment findings
note: [2026-10-14 weekly planning] OPERATOR-APPROVED 2026-10-14 (Tier-2, order-path-adjacent; approval recorded here, relayed by the manager). Source: PI-20261007-APBY4NTV-0007 -- prop_feed_tick.sh maps every FeasibilityError incl. unknown_page ('Loading...') and timeout to rc 4 = trip on first occurrence, never retried, so a ~4-min Tradeify blip stopped tradeify_1 for 26 h+. Build: a distinct exit for environment-class findings so the 3-failure path decides, one auto re-check after a cool-down, --dump-dir on the trip path only; rc 4 unchanged for captcha/2fa/challenge/login_rejected/password_expired/no_credentials/asn_blocked/access_denied. NO-HALT applies: the feed keeps trying and raises one flag. Verify on the VM post-state (prop journal) after deploy.  [2026-10-15 lane] PR #18164 (draft, hold/tier_2_3_needs_approval) built+tested (78 pass); NOT merged/deployed/observed. Closes only when the prop journal shows a timeout/unknown_page outage retried next tick while captcha/2fa/login_rejected still rc 4. --dump-dir on trip path deliberately not built (no-op on login failure).
